findings.problem: The target verb appears only as an infinitive after tienes que, but the example should show enfrentar conjugated.
findings.fix: example.es: Mi hermano enfrenta sus problemas con calma. / example.en: My brother faces his problems calmly.

back.example: You have to face your fears.

note: The hint is useful because it separates this meaning of to face from mirar hacia (to face a direction), and the less common afrontar is no real competitor in everyday Latin American speech.
